name: Get live updates token
description: Call this when the UI needs a token to subscribe to real‑time analytics updates (e.g., live dashboards, conversation streams). If the user does not have any active integrations, use the action to prompt the user to set up an integration instead.
preconditions: The user must have at least one active integration configured.

token.description: A JWT or opaque token that can be used to open a live‑updates connection.

error.description: Error message describing why a token could not be issued.

side_effects: None; the call only retrieves a token or an error message.
